title: If you are asking for human attention, demonstrate human effort
summary: A thoughtful essay arguing that when requesting human attention or help, one should first demonstrate personal effort and due diligence. The author emphasizes the ethical responsibility of showing genuine investment before asking others to invest their time and attention, applicable to AI interactions, professional requests, and interpersonal communication.
problem_solved: Addresses the common problem of people asking for help without first doing their own research or showing personal effort.
why_valuable: Promotes a culture of mutual respect for time and attention, encouraging self-reliance before burdening others with requests.
